articles.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
articles.snippet: The scheme allegedly stole tens of millions through Russian-language Facebook ads and fake advisers, then went after victims again with fake recovery offers.

articles.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
articles.snippet: U.S.-linked wallets account for just over 88% of tracked AI model payments, dwarfing China’s 0.1% share, according to new Chainalysis research.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
articles.snippet: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

articles.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
articles.snippet: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.

articles.title: Thailand crypto ETFs may see slow start despite new rules: CoinShares
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules take effect Friday, but CoinShares expects modest initial inflows as existing investment options compete for demand.
